whistleblower_protection: disclose information to the attorney general

definitions.impact_assessment: A mandatory formal impact or risk assessment that a regulated actor must conduct for an AI system or deployment. Exclude inventories or metadata fields that merely mention whether an impact assessment exists, general reasonable-care duties, standing risk-management programs, ordinary testing, and a developer's duty merely to provide documents so another actor can complete an assessment.
definitions.risk_management: A mandatory policy, program, framework, governance process, or mitigation process that the regulated actor must implement to identify and manage AI risk. Exclude one-off impact assessments, bare prohibitions, and duties only to describe or transmit risk-management information. If a developer merely supplies risk information or use instructions to a deployer, code developer_documentation instead unless the developer is independently commanded to operate a risk-management process.
definitions.model_evaluation: A mandatory technical test, evaluation, red-team exercise, capability assessment, or performance assessment that the regulated actor must conduct. Documentation describing how a system was evaluated is developer_documentation unless the provision independently commands an evaluation.
definitions.human_oversight: A duty or individual right requiring a human person to review, intervene in, supervise, or make a decision. Exclude internal governance, generic safety controls, documentation explaining how a system should be monitored, and harmful-use prohibitions with no human reviewer. A disclosure that a person may seek human review is consumer_notice unless the same provision or another operative provision actually grants or requires the human review right.
definitions.consumer_notice: A direct notice or disclosure to a specific consumer, user, patient, worker, or person interacting with or affected by AI. This includes a patient-facing statement that a communication was generated by AI when the legal duty is simply to inform the recipient. Exclude public website reports and business-to-business technical documentation supplied to a developer or deployer. An adverse-outcome notice is consumer_notice unless the statute separately imposes an anti-discrimination duty.
definitions.developer_documentation: A mandatory business-to-business duty to create, retain, or supply model cards, dataset cards, technical documentation, system-use instructions, evaluation documentation, impact-assessment support, known-risk information, or similar information to a developer, deployer, customer organization, or regulator. Exclude direct consumer notice and generally available public transparency reports. Investigative demands issued by a regulator are enforcement_authority, not developer_documentation.
definitions.public_transparency: A mandatory public website posting, public report, public framework, or public disclosure available generally rather than delivered to a specific affected person or downstream business. A requirement to include assessment summaries or safety information in a public transparency report remains public_transparency unless a separate provision independently commands the underlying assessment.
definitions.explanation_appeal: An individual right or corresponding duty involving reasons, explanation, correction, appeal, contest, reconsideration, or review of an AI-influenced decision.
definitions.antidiscrimination: A prohibition, reasonable-care duty, mitigation duty, or other enforceable requirement expressly aimed at unlawful discrimination or discriminatory AI outcomes. Do not infer antidiscrimination from an adverse decision, adverse outcome, protected consumer process, or general fairness language unless the operative provision itself targets discrimination or a protected class.
definitions.incident_reporting: A mandatory duty on a regulated developer, deployer, employer, provider, or other covered entity to report a qualifying AI incident, harm, safety event, or discriminatory outcome to a regulator or affected party. Exclude consumer complaint channels, a regulator's duty merely to establish a reporting mechanism, regulator reports about its own enforcement work, and periodic transmission of assessments that are not incident-triggered reports.
definitions.frontier_safety: A substantive safety, risk, mitigation, evaluation, statement-integrity, or incident-management duty specific to frontier/foundation models or catastrophic risk. This includes prohibitions on materially false or misleading catastrophic-risk statements and periodic catastrophic-risk assessment duties. Do not use this domain for every transparency or reporting duty merely because the law concerns frontier AI; use public_transparency when the operative duty is only public disclosure and incident_reporting only when a qualifying incident triggers the report.
definitions.harmful_use_restriction: A substantive prohibition on developing, deploying, or using AI to cause or facilitate physical harm, self-harm, criminal conduct, coercion, or similarly harmful conduct. Use child_safety instead when the rule is specifically limited to minors. Do not code a harmful-use prohibition as human oversight unless the law separately requires a human reviewer.
definitions.child_safety: An AI-specific prohibition, design duty, disclosure, safeguard, or right intended specifically to protect minors or children. A self-harm detection or response duty applying to users generally belongs in risk_management or harmful_use_restriction, not child_safety solely because children may benefit.
definitions.health_restriction: An AI-specific substantive restriction, human-review duty, safeguard, or limitation governing health care, clinical decisions, insurance medical necessity, therapy, or similar health uses. A disclosure-only statement that a patient communication was AI-generated is consumer_notice, not health_restriction. A provision that removes another duty when a human provider reviews the output is an exemption if it narrows application of the AI-specific requirement.
definitions.synthetic_content: A duty or prohibition concerning labeling, watermarking, provenance, detection, or disclosure of AI-generated or manipulated synthetic content as content provenance. Do not use this domain for a recipient-specific disclaimer that a health or service communication was generated by AI when the rule does not regulate synthetic-content provenance; use consumer_notice instead.
definitions.whistleblower_protection: A protection against retaliation, confidentiality rule, or reporting right for workers or insiders who disclose AI safety risks or legal violations.
definitions.infrastructure: An AI-specific rule governing compute, data centers, power, grid effects, siting, or permitting.
definitions.government_use: A substantive restriction or duty governing a government entity's procurement, deployment, or use of AI. Exclude an agency's administrative, study, enforcement, or reporting responsibilities unless they directly constrain government AI use.
definitions.enforcement_authority: Express statutory authority for a regulator or public official to investigate, enforce, issue civil investigative demands, seek injunctions, issue orders, apply an incorporated consumer-protection enforcement regime, or otherwise compel compliance. Do not treat the mere existence of enforcement authority as a monetary penalty unless a separate provision specifies a penalty.
definitions.private_right: An express private civil cause of action or right to sue. A complaint process or regulator petition is not a private right of action. If the statute expressly states that no private right exists, a negative row with covered=false and strength=0 may be retained as an explicit enforcement-structure fact.
definitions.penalty: An express civil, administrative, or criminal monetary or nonmonetary penalty for violation of an AI-specific duty. Incorporation of another statute's enforcement authority without a stated penalty amount belongs in enforcement_authority unless the incorporated provision clearly supplies a penalty.
definitions.exemption: An express exemption, safe harbor, sector carve-out, human-review exception, small-entity exception, or other provision removing or reducing application of an AI-specific obligation. Exclude public-records confidentiality exemptions and other exemptions from unrelated background statutes that do not reduce the AI law's coverage.
